WITH tmp1 AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id,
           sum(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
           avg(sum(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item i
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222, 1223, 1224, 1225, 1226, 1227, 1228, 1229, 1230, 1231, 1232)
        AND ((i_category in ('Books','Children','Electronics') AND i_class in ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') 
             AND i_brand in ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
          OR (i_category in ('Women','Music','Men') AND i_class in ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
             AND i_brand in ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')))
    GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy
)
SELECT tmp1.i_manager_id,
       sum_sales AS sum_sales,
       avg_monthly_sales AS avg_monthly_sales,
       CASE 
           WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN 
               (abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales)
           ELSE NULL
       AS deviance
FROM tmp1
WHERE deviance > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
